selection: Lowest development RMSE; freeze before evaluation; never use evaluation for selection.
covariate_policy: Conditions on provided exogenous covariates; no future rental labels.
baseline: Regional RNN/CatBoost/conditional-GMM/MLP with full-training stack inputs; fit fresh weights under the specified split.
shared_corrections: Temporal inner selection; refit on all origin-permitted rows; per-fit flat-model price ranking; GPU execution.
overlap: Development (2023-07..2023-12) and evaluation (2024-01..2025-03) do not overlap. The six-month development period selects the variant; the fifteen-month evaluation tests transfer to the longer horizon.
